_ap3_note: Plexco writer contract for ap3 (DESIGN.md section 4, as corrected by W1-DECISION-codex-sandbox.md and wave 1.1). The writer does CODING ONLY inside the sandbox and stops at .ap3-run/READY-FOR-REVIEW; the dispatcher runs the Codex review, the push and the PR unsandboxed, because codex cannot initialize inside Seatbelt. So the writer needs NO openai domains and NO gh/codex/push rules. This file is the SOURCE the installer resolves into ap3/writer-settings.json, which the dispatcher passes PER RUN via `claude --settings <abs path> --setting-sources ''`; .claude/settings.json is never modified (installing it repo-wide on 2026-09-09 blocked gh/git push/docker/psql in the owner's own sessions). Plexco-specific vs the kit template: pnpm instead of npm, mcp__gitnexus__*, localhost/127.0.0.1 for the Docker Postgres on 5432 that pnpm test:db needs, allowWrite for the pnpm store, and psql/db:bootstrap explicitly denied.
